# Unknown IITians

> Unknown IITians (unknowniitians.com) is an Indian online education platform for
> IIT Madras BS Degree (IITM BS) aspirants and students, plus JEE and NEET
> learners. It provides free subject-wise notes and previous year questions
> (PYQs), live courses for the IITM BS Qualifier and Foundation levels, and free
> tools (CGPA calculator, grade calculator, marks predictor).

## What Unknown IITians offers
- Free IITM BS notes for Data Science and Electronic Systems, organised by branch, level (Qualifier, Foundation, Diploma, Degree) and subject.
- Free IITM BS previous year questions (PYQs) with solutions.
- Live courses for the IITM BS Qualifier and Foundation exams.
- Free JEE and NEET notes and PYQs.
- Free IITM BS tools: CGPA calculator, grade calculator, marks predictor.

## Key pages
- [All courses](https://www.unknowniitians.com/courses): live IITM BS, JEE and NEET batches.
- [IITM BS notes](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/notes): free subject-wise PDF notes.
- [IITM BS PYQs](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/pyqs): previous year questions with solutions.
- [IITM BS important dates](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/dates): exam, quiz and OPPE schedule.
- [IITM BS tools](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/tools): CGPA / grade / marks calculators.
- [JEE preparation](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/jee/notes): free JEE notes and PYQs.
- [NEET preparation](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/neet/notes): free NEET notes and PYQs.
- [About Unknown IITians](https://www.unknowniitians.com/about)
